topic: Effects of Temperature on Matter: Freezing and Melting
key_concepts: Matter can change form when heated or cooled
Temperature affects the form of matter
A thermometer measures temperature in degrees Celsius and Fahrenheit
Hot objects have high temperature and cold objects have low temperature
Melting is the change from solid to liquid
Freezing is the change from liquid to solid
Ice melts into water when placed in a warm place
Water freezes into ice when placed in a freezer
Butter, chocolate, and ice cream can melt when heated
Water, juice, and milk can freeze when cooled
The boiling point of water is 100°C
